title: YouTube Library
summary: A record of an empty YouTube-library project shell that retains the possible cataloging idea and its boundary between source, credentials, and app data.
epitaph: The library left no books, only labels on two empty rooms.
revive_when: Saved videos need durable reasons, topics, and notes that a platform queue does not provide, and those needs are concrete enough to define without importing private account data.

related.reason: A revived video catalog could attach selected videos and the reasons they matter to Problem Space nodes, giving saved media problem context instead of creating another undifferentiated queue.

origin: User supplied the local old-repos-to-grave/youtube-library directory for burial on 2026-09-13 and asked that secrets, databases, and real app data be excluded. The directory was not a Git repository and contained no files: only empty data and credential-named directories. The caretaker inspected directory metadata without reading or preserving any credentials or app data, preserved no source because none was present, and inferred the cataloging concept only from the project name and directory roles. The material was not executed.
